title: Retained Layout Orchestration v1
problem: Fresh local layout evidence pointed at retained-tree/barrier orchestration around Semantics, root Scroll, and ViewCache rather than a clean-geometry model rewrite.

repro.summary: Historical repro for the closed Semantics fast-path slice: capture the UI Gallery code-editor resize-jitter perf script with ViewCache enabled, then use diag stats to classify retained layout orchestration ownership.
commands: target/release/fretboard-dev diag perf tools/diag-scripts/ui-gallery/code-editor/ui-gallery-code-editor-window-resize-drag-jitter-steady.json --repeat 1 --warmup-frames 5 --reuse-launch --prewarm-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prewarm-fonts.json --prelude-script tools/diag-scripts/_prelude/tooling-suite-prelude-reset-diagnostics.json --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE=1 --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE_SHELL=1 --env FRET_DIAG_RENDERER_PERF=1 --env FRET_DIAG_SCRIPT_AUTO_DUMP=0 --env FRET_DIAG_SEMANTICS=0 --dir target/fret-diag/retained-layout-orchestration-v1-baseline --launch -- cargo run -p fret-ui-gallery --release --features gallery-full
